Hudders Former employee of American Express Travel Related Services Company, Inc., New York, New York Misapplication of funds and conflicts of interest Consent prohibition order against Elvisha White Former employee of Regions Bank, Birmingham, Alabama Check fraud Additional enforcement actions can be searched for here .
